claim_verdicts.evidence: Round 2: s6 bullet 2 now uses the round-1 suggested_text. PG 17 PREPARE TRANSACTION: 'Its purpose is to allow an external transaction manager to perform atomic global transactions across multiple databases'; Caution: 'committed or rolled back as soon as an external transaction manager has verified that other databases are also prepared to commit.' The decision is the manager's; the lesson now frames 'must not decide alone' as a protocol rule, not a PostgreSQL restriction.

PG 17 PREPARE TRANSACTION, Description: 'its state is fully stored on disk, and there is a very high probability that it can be committed successfully, even if a database crash occurs before the commit is requested.'

PG 17 PREPARE TRANSACTION, Caution: 'Keep in mind also that the transaction continues to hold whatever locks it held.' Description: 'Once prepared, a transaction can later be committed or rolled back with COMMIT PREPARED or ROLLBACK PREPARED'. ROLLBACK PREPARED notes: same user or superuser, 'you do not have to be in the same session' - supports s4 'or until someone ends the prepared transaction by hand'.

PG 17 PREPARE TRANSACTION, Notes: 'PREPARE TRANSACTION is not intended for use in applications or interactive sessions. Its purpose is to allow an external transaction manager to perform atomic global transactions across multiple databases or other transactional resources.'

PG 17 runtime-config-resource, max_prepared_transactions: 'Setting this parameter to zero (which is the default) disables the prepared-transaction feature. This parameter can only be set at server start.' Captured output at stage-3 shows ' 0'.

Captured run at stage-3, lines 11-13: "PREPARE TRANSACTION 'refund-order-1';" / 'ERROR:  prepared transactions are disabled' / 'HINT:  Set "max_prepared_transactions" to a nonzero value.' Lesson output block matches the capture verbatim.

PG 17 PREPARE TRANSACTION: 'If the PREPARE TRANSACTION command fails for any reason, it becomes a ROLLBACK: the current transaction is canceled.' Capture lines 14-18: SELECT status ... ' paid'. Seed @ stage-3: '( 1, 1, '2026-03-02 09:15:00+07', 'paid')'.

refund-design.md @ stage-3 lines 69-74: 'RabbitMQ không tham gia được transaction của PostgreSQL, API HTTP của cổng không có bước prepare, và chính PostgreSQL của Đơn Hàng tắt `PREPARE TRANSACTION` (`max_prepared_transactions` là 0). issues.text: New in the round-1 change. 'By hand' leaves me guessing who does it and how. Core concepts says the coordinator ends a prepared transaction with COMMIT PREPARED or ROLLBACK PREPARED, so I can guess a person types one of those, but the lesson never says so. I also cannot tell whether that person would pick commit or roll back.
issues.quote: Those rows stay locked until the coordinator returns, or until someone ends the prepared transaction by hand.
issues.fix: Replace 'ends the prepared transaction by hand' with 'runs `COMMIT PREPARED` or `ROLLBACK PREPARED` for it by hand'.
